workflows.name: Investor outreach emails
workflows.description: Drafts your investor outreach emails in your own tone, a batch at a time, and sends them from Gmail after you approve the batch. Replaces: 495 new emails to 461 people at 50 organisations, written one by one
workflows.arithmetic: 99/day × 5 days × 3.0 min = 24.8 h/wk → review 495 × 20 s = 2.8 h/wk → saves 22.0 h/wk (89%)
